title: Sensei Workspace Identity V1
description: A closed, versioned composition of existing Sensei-owned facts about one checkout: configured repository identity, revision/tree binding, graph authority, coverage, and optional task identity. Evidence, not permission.
$comment: Canonical producer/owner: globulario/sensei. This is a Sensei-core truth receipt, not a Dashboard-authored approximation. A consumer (e.g. globulario/sensei-dashboard) must pin an exact accepted Sensei commit and this file's sha256 digest, and must reject any document whose schema_version it does not exactly recognize rather than partially interpret it. schema_version is a const, not a range: any field addition, removal, rename, or semantic change requires a new schema identifier. composition_state reports only whether this receipt could be composed completely — it is NEVER mutation admission, correctness certification, provider authorization, or a merge recommendation; see sensei.workspace.admission.v1 for admission truth. This contract deliberately omits repository-root hash, MCP server/session id, worktree id, job id, and provider id — Sensei does not own those facts; a runner (not yet implemented) binds and compares its own copies of them against this receipt's repository/revision/graph/task facts.

composition_state.$comment: complete: every governed fact below resolved cleanly. partial: some governed facts resolved, at least one did not. unavailable: the receipt could not be meaningfully composed (e.g. no configured repository domain, or the metadata backend was unreachable). complete REQUIRES binding.revision_status=resolved, binding.graph_digest_status=resolved, repository_domain_source=configured, and graph_authority non-null with authoritative=true — a producer must never report complete with any of those unresolved.

repository_domain_source.$comment: configured: repository_domain came from this checkout's canonical .sensei/config.yaml repository.domain — the only source that can produce composition_state=complete. unbound: no repository.domain is configured. Environment variables (SENSEI_DOMAIN, legacy AWG_DOMAIN) and git remote origin are never a source of governed workspace identity, even when observed as diagnostic context elsewhere; they never appear here.

graph_authority.$comment: null only when composition_state=unavailable and the metadata backend could not be reached at all; any other case must supply a graph_authority object, even one reporting an empty/unknown/check_error freshness state.

coverage_state.$comment: Mirrors the closed Sensei CoverageState vocabulary (proto awareness_graph.proto) verbatim — never a Dashboard-authored translation.

binding.$comment: Reuses architecture.ClaimDocumentBinding's exact semantics. revision and tree_digest_sha256 are independently optional: an admitted-but-uncommitted working tree can be represented by tree_digest_sha256 alone, without pretending it has a revision (required proof: 'uncommitted admitted trees can be represented by tree digest without pretending they have a revision').

graphAuthority.$comment: A bounded external projection of GraphAuthority/MetadataResponse (proto awareness_graph.proto) needed by a runner. Field names and enum spellings are verbatim proto names — not renamed for external presentation — so this receipt can be cross-checked directly against docs/api-reference.md and the .proto source.

taskIdentity.$comment: not_requested: the caller did not ask sensei_workspace_status to resolve a task. resolved: a deterministic Sensei task_id was found. unavailable: a task was requested but could not be resolved (no active task, unknown task, or a local task-artifact read failure). task_id is present if and only if state=resolved.
